question: What transformation of the body is claimed after removal of ignorance's veil?
premises: The speaker refers to her own body today.
The body is described as pure.
It was previously struck by the veil of ignorance.
inference: The speaker claims her body is now pure, having been freed from ignorance's veil.
uncertainties: deham appears in accusative form though used as subject in this line.
plain_english: Today my body is pure, though it was struck by the veil of ignorance.
